audit.summary: All three ad formats (320×480, 336×280, 300×250) meet IAB pixel dimensions and display Red Bull Bowl Rippers branding correctly. Logo is visible and properly scaled across all units. Typography hierarchy is clear with bold event title, location/date in primary yellow, and French CTA button. Product imagery (skateboarding action shots) is prominent and well-integrated. Color palette adheres to brand guidelines (navy background, red-bull yellow accent, white type). Animation states show smooth carousel transitions with carousel indicators. No blockers identified; all deliverables are broadcast-ready.
audit.regeneration_prompt: No patches required. All formats meet brand standards, pixel dimensions are correct, logo visibility is excellent, typography is properly hierarchied, colors match the style guide, French copy is accurate ('MARSEILLE · 2026', 'L'élite mondiale du bowl skate', 'Vivez l'adrénaline', 'DÉCOUVRIR'), product imagery is strong and well-composed, and animation carousel indicators are present and functional across all three sizes.
